Prolius Ltd.main_product: Fleet and workforce management software with integrated telematics
Prolius Ltd.reason: Prolius provides a centralized fleet management system that includes built-in telematics, GPS vehicle tracking, video telematics, driver behavior monitoring, and comprehensive fleet compliance software.

Pocket Box Ltd.main_product: Fleet management and vehicle tracking software
Pocket Box Ltd.reason: Pocket Box Fleet is an all-in-one cloud-based fleet management platform that natively provides vehicle tracking, AI-powered vehicle cameras, and compliance management as its main product offerings.

Radius Limited.main_product: Fuel cards and fleet payment solutions
Radius Limited.reason: Radius Limited started as a fuel card provider and its primary business ecosystem centers on fuel cards, vehicle leasing, telecoms, and EV charging, making its telematics solution an adjacent add-on fleet service.

Terramar Networks Limited.main_product: Connected fleet platform and asset tracking software (tracpoint)
Terramar Networks Limited.reason: Terramar Networks' primary business is providing vehicle telematics, GPS vehicle tracking, asset monitoring, and fleet management software (via their proprietary web application 'tracpoint') for commercial, maritime, mining, and humanitarian fleets.

Corvia Limited.main_product: Bus smart ticketing and electronic ticket machine systems
Corvia Limited.reason: Ticketer's primary offering is cloud-based electronic ticket machines (ETMs) and smart ticketing software tailored specifically for the bus and coach industry. While their platform captures live telemetry and provides vehicle tracking modules for fleet visibility, schedule adherence, and BODS compliance data, these capabilities function as add-ons integrated within its core public transport ticketing and operations product.
